scope: Proposition 6.3 (Local lists and compatible hits) of the manuscript “The Factor-Two Hardness Threshold for Vertex Cover” (preprints/The-Factor-Two-Hardness-Threshold-for-Vertex-Cover-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 102 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4c8faec31a1af3d0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The functions Lj are deterministic total measurable maps returning at most ℓ valid labels. Once Φ, F, J, a and the conditional kernels above are fixed, each list uses only its own questions uj and weights sj. In particular it has no additional access to the actual hidden seed occurrences or to any other actual batch input. Under the fixed restricted product law, EZ ≥ βh 2 = 2. (6.15)
